T: The saddest thing in life is a wasted dinner.
D: A bus driver's son is torn between his honest father and the neighbourhood boss.
P: Do the car door test before dessert comes out.
S: bar food from Sonny's place, Chez Bippy

Big green olives stuffed with sharp provolone, crumbed and fried until crackling, with lemon aioli and a dusting of chilli. Drain 24 large pitted green olives and pat dry. Cut 80g sharp provolone into small sticks and push one into each olive. Roll in 40g plain flour, dip in 1 beaten egg, then coat in 80g fine breadcrumbs. Heat oil to 180C and fry in two batches for 2 minutes until deep golden, then drain. Stir the zest and juice of half a lemon and 1 crushed garlic clove into 100g mayonnaise. Dust the olives with chilli flakes and serve with the aioli.
Cut eggplant into fingers, salt 30 minutes, pat dry. Flour, egg, panko mixed with parmesan, fry at 180C until golden. Warm marinara for dipping.
eaten on the stoop while the street corner singers warm up
Cut pizza dough into strips, tie knots, prove 30 minutes, bake at 230C for 12 minutes. Toss straight from the oven in garlic butter with parsley and parmesan.
M: gravy and meatballs at the neighbourhood boss's table
Brown pork and beef meatballs and a few pork ribs, then simmer in tomato sauce with garlic and basil for 2 hours. Toss rigatoni with sauce, meat on a platter.
wrapped in paper for the bus route
Grill Italian sausages, then soften sliced capsicum and onion in the same pan with oregano. Pile into a long roll with provolone, wrap in baking paper to steam 5 minutes.
W: a box from Belmont's bakery for Sonny
Drained ricotta beaten with icing sugar, vanilla and mini choc chips, piped into bought shells right before serving, ends in crushed pistachio.
K: Short espresso in a demitasse with 15ml anisette or sambuca on the side to pour in, a curl of lemon peel.

Mix the mushrooms with the ricotta, egg, breadcrumbs, parmesan, salt and pepper and shape into 12 meatballs.
Brown the meatballs and eggplant in the rest of the olive oil in a heavy pot, turning gently, then set aside.
Soften the onion, add the garlic, then the tomatoes, water and basil and simmer until rich.
Return the meatballs and eggplant and simmer gently until heated through.
Boil the rigatoni, drain and toss with the sauce. Serve the meatballs on a platter.

edition.tagline: The saddest thing in life is a wasted dinner.
edition.cue: Do the car door test before dessert comes out.

s.note: Big green olives stuffed with sharp provolone, crumbed and fried until crackling, with lemon aioli and a dusting of chilli.
s.how: Drain 24 large pitted green olives and pat dry. Cut 80g sharp provolone into small sticks and push one into each olive. Roll in 40g plain flour, dip in 1 beaten egg, then coat in 80g fine breadcrumbs. Heat oil to 180C and fry in two batches for 2 minutes until deep golden, then drain. Stir the zest and juice of half a lemon and 1 crushed garlic clove into 100g mayonnaise. Dust the olives with chilli flakes and serve with the aioli.

s.note: Fresh baked dough knots tossed in garlic butter, parsley and parmesan.
s.how: Cut 400g pizza dough into 12 strips and tie each in a loose knot. Place on a lined tray, cover and prove in a warm place for 30 minutes. Bake at 230°C conventional for 12 minutes until golden. Melt 50g butter with 2 finely minced garlic cloves over low heat for 2 minutes. Toss the hot knots straight from the oven with the garlic butter, 2 tbsp chopped parsley and 30g finely grated parmesan.

m.note: Slow tomato sauce, pork and beef meatballs, tender ribs and basil.
m.how: Mix 400g pork and beef mince with 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs, 1/2 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp black pepper; shape into 12 meatballs. Brown the meatballs and 400g pork ribs in 2 tbsp olive oil in a heavy pot for 8 minutes, turning, then set aside. Soften 1 diced onion for 5 minutes, add 3 sliced garlic cloves for 1 minute, then add 800g tinned tomatoes, 200ml water and 10 basil leaves. Return the meat, cover partly and simmer gently for 2 hours, stirring occasionally and adding water if needed. Check the ribs are tender and the meatballs are cooked through. Boil 400g rigatoni in salted water for the packet time, drain and toss with sauce. Serve the meat on a platter with the pasta.

w.note: Crisp shells filled with vanilla ricotta, chocolate chips and crushed pistachio.
w.how: Drain 250g fresh ricotta in a lined sieve in the fridge for at least 2 hours. Beat with 40g icing sugar and 1/2 tsp vanilla extract until smooth; fold in 30g mini chocolate chips. Pipe into 8 small bought cannoli shells just before serving. Dip the ends in 30g finely crushed pistachios. Serve two small cannoli per person.

d.note: Short espresso with anisette on the side and fresh lemon peel.
d.how: Use 36g espresso beans to brew four 30ml short espressos into warmed demitasse cups. Serve 15ml anisette or sambuca beside each cup for pouring in. Cut four small curls from the remaining peel of the lemon used for the olives, avoiding bitter white pith, and serve one with each coffee.
